messages.content:
ある質問が、次の候補のうちどれについて尋ねているかを判定してください。

質問: wikictl のソースコード（テストを除く）において、パスの要素が MaxNameLen バイトを超えた際にエラーを返す処理を実行する関数を直接呼び出している関数、およびそれらを直接呼び出している関数（2 段まで）をすべて挙げよ。

候補:
A. listItem reports whether t starts a list item: "-", "*", "+", or up to nine digits followed by "." or ")", indented by up to three spaces and followed by a space or a tab. num is the number of an ordered item, and "" otherwise.
B. destPath returns the path of a link destination: the text before a query or a fragment.
C. Frontmatter returns the top-level keys of the frontmatter of content, in the order they are written, each with the line it is written on and its value. ok is false when content has no frontmatter; a frontmatter that has no key gives an empty list. The values come from decoding the whole frontmatter,
D. headings reads the headings outside code fences. linksStart is the index of the "## Links" heading when it is the last heading, or -1 when the page has no Links section. notLast holds the indexes of the other "## Links" headings, which do not start the Links section because another heading follows. 
E. rewrite applies fn to every page link outside code fences and code spans. fn receives the path of the destination as written and the resolved target, and returns the new path; the rest of the destination is kept.
F. CheckLength returns an error when a component of p, which may be a single name, is over MaxNameLen bytes.
G. skipSpace returns the index of the first byte at or after byte i of s that is not a space or a tab, allowing one line break among them.
H. escaped reports whether byte i of s is a backslash that escapes the ASCII punctuation character after it.

- 質問の内容に最も合う候補の記号を choice に書く。
- 二つ以上の候補が同じくらい当てはまり、質問だけではどれか決められないときは ambiguous を true にする。
- reason に判断の理由を短く書く。
JSON で答えてください。

content: {"choice": "F", "ambiguous": false, "reason": "質問にある「パスの要素が MaxNameLen バイトを超えた際にエラーを返す処理」という記述が、候補Fの「CheckLength returns an error when a component of p... is over MaxNameLen bytes」と完全に一致するため。"}
